jobs.description:
Execute Precision Manufacturing at the Core of a Deep-Tech Scale-Up
At Smart High Tech, we are transforming advanced materials into industrial production. Our graphene-based technology enables the next generation of AI systems, electronics and data centres, where performance depends on precision, quality and consistency.
As we scale production, we are looking for Production Operators who take pride in executing critical manufacturing processes with accuracy, discipline and attention to detail.
Your Mission
You will play a key role in ensuring stable, safe and high-quality production.
Your work directly impacts:

Product quality

Process stability

Production efficiency

What You Will DoProduction Operations
Operate production equipment such as furnaces, coating lines and cutting machines.

Perform material-handling, loading, and unloading activities.

Ensure process parameters remain within defined specifications.

Follow production schedules and work instructions.

Quality & Process Control
Monitor production performance and process conditions.

Perform visual and dimensional quality inspections.

Identify, report and escalate deviations.

Support consistent product quality and process stability.

Equipment & Maintenance
Perform basic preventive maintenance and daily inspections.

Maintain equipment cleanliness and operational readiness.

Report technical issues and abnormalities to Maintenance.

Documentation & Safety
Register production data, material usage and quality observations.

Ensure accurate and timely documentation.

Maintain a clean, organised and safe work environment.

Follow all safety procedures and operational standards.

Key Interfaces
You will work closely with:

Production Leader

Production Engineers

Maintenance Team

Quality Department

Operations & Planning

Who You Are
You are reliable, quality-focused and enjoy working in a structured production environment.
Required Qualifications
Upper secondary education in Industrial Technology, Manufacturing or similar.

Experience from manufacturing, production or process industries.

Strong ability to follow instructions and work systematically.

High focus on quality, safety and accuracy.

Good communication skills in Swedish and English.

Willingness to work shifts.

Meritorious
Experience operating furnaces, coating lines or similar process equipment.

Experience from thermal processes, surface treatment or advanced manufacturing.

Technical interest and basic mechanical understanding.

Additional language skills.

Why Join Smart High Tech?
This is an opportunity to work with advanced manufacturing technologies in a fast-growing deep-tech company.
You will:

Be part of scaling innovative technology into global production.

Work in a modern manufacturing environment with advanced processes.

Receive support and training from experienced engineers and specialists.

Contribute directly to product quality and operational success.

Join a team where precision, responsibility and teamwork are highly valued.

What Success Looks Like
Within your first months, you have:

Learned and mastered key production processes.

Operated equipment independently and safely.

Maintained stable output and quality standards.

Contributed to efficient production and continuous improvement.

Consumer Communications Consultant
About the assignment
Our client is a leading international pharmaceutical company with a strong presence in Sweden. We are looking for someone who is passionate about creating great engagement and telling the best story. You will help people in Sweden understand a widespread chronic health condition, feel confident about seeking the right care, and build lasting trust in the company and its brands.
Key responsibilities
Shape and deliver consumer communicationsTurn consumer insights and data into stories people relate to and trust. Create content that makes people understand, feel and act, and want to come back.
Meet consumers where they areRun campaigns and keep the conversation going across social media, content creators, online communities and the press. Find the right tone for each audience.
Bring the consumer voice into the roomUse research, social listening and everyday dialogue to shape what happens next. Work with cross-functional teams to make use of insights from across the organization.
Make it happenOwn projects from idea to launch, including budgets, timelines and agencies. Work closely with commercial, medical, legal/compliance and press functions.
Do it right and show the impactMake sure all published material follows the regulations and goes through the internal review and approval process. Track how well people understand, trust and engage with the content, and how it supports business goals. Then use what you learn to improve.

What this could look like in practice
Translating the company's key messages so the story feels natural to consumers and stays true to the science.
Planning events for consumers or content creators.
Leading the Swedish adaptation of global campaigns and earning attention through consumer activation.
Working closely with press colleagues so that the media also want to tell the story.

Experience and capabilities
Several years of professional experience in PR and communications.
Experience in consumer communications, ideally from consumer goods or FMCG, building relationships with consumers over time. OTC or consumer healthcare experience is a plus.
Hands-on experience with social media, content creators and online communities, and a flair for turning science into content people want to read and share.
An understanding of how communication works in pharma, including the difference between raising disease awareness and promoting a product.
Good commercial sense, and experience running projects, agencies and budgets with many stakeholders.
Good knowledge of Swedish media, and excellent written and spoken Swedish and English.

Meritorious
Many years of experience in communications.
Experience working in large companies and global organizations.

What success looks like
People in Sweden prefer the company and its brands, and the company leads the public conversation in its therapy area. There is an active, lasting relationship with the consumer community. Consumer communications, commercial teams and press pull in the same direction to build understanding and trust and support the commercial strategy, always within the regulations.

Are you passionate about product quality, customer perception, and vehicle development? Do you enjoy combining technical analysis with cross-functional collaboration to create products that meet the highest standards?
ALTEN is now looking for a Quality Impression Feature Engineer for an assignment towards one of our clients within the automotive industry. In this role, you will support the development and evaluation of vehicle features, contributing to the overall quality impression and customer experience of heavy-duty vehicles.
About the role
As a Quality Impression Feature Engineer, you will work closely with engineering teams throughout the product development process, supporting feature development through requirements management, verification activities, testing, and evaluation. You will assess both virtual and physical products, providing insights and recommendations to ensure a high-quality end-user experience.
The role also includes contributing to the long-term development of quality impression methods, feature definitions, test approaches, and roadmaps, making it an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys both hands-on evaluation and strategic improvement work.
Main responsibilities
Manage and support feature requirements throughout the development process
Perform verification, testing, and evaluation of virtual models and physical products
Assess feature status and provide recommendations to project teams
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to support product development
Contribute to the development of feature definitions, methods, and verification approaches
Support long-term development and continuous improvement initiatives
Report feature status and progress to project stakeholders

Your profile
You are a curious and analytical engineer with a strong interest in product quality and customer experience. You enjoy evaluating products from both a technical and user perspective and are comfortable working across multiple functions and disciplines.
We see that you have:
B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Engineering, Industrial Design, Product Development, or equivalent
Experience from the automotive industry or product development environments
Experience working with verification, testing, or product evaluation
Ability to analyze results and provide structured feedback
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
Fluent in English, both written and spoken

Meritorious:
Experience within Quality Impression or Perceived Quality
Experience with CAE tools, visualization, or 3D rendering
Experience working with vehicle development projects
Experience defining requirements and test methods

About ALTEN
ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest technology and engineering consulting companies, with more than 57,000 employees in over 30 countries. In Sweden, we are a leading engineering consultancy within automotive, telecom, defense, energy, and industry.
At ALTEN, we believe in growing together with our employees. Through exciting assignments, technical development, and a strong company culture, we create opportunities for our engineers to develop both professionally and personally.
Welcome to read more about us at alten.se!

For any HR-related questions or request regarding a job application, please select the ‘Recruitment’ category in “Contact us”.

Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   Join our Team    
 About the opportunity
 At 5G/6G Baseband System Management, we define how advanced radio network functions should behave in the 5G/6G RAN. Our work spans radio communication, signal processing, system studies, software simulation, 3GPP standardization, baseband architecture, and real customer networks.
 We are looking for a Radio Network Systems Engineer to join our team and work on the technologies behind the next generation of mobile communication. You will combine technical analysis and software simulation with system-level thinking, standards work, and collaboration across development teams. You will also have the opportunity to contribute to AI/ML-related developments and AI-assisted engineering, as these technologies become increasingly relevant to future radio systems and development workflows.
  
 What you will do
 •    Perform system studies in the Radio Physical Layer for radio functions such as Beamforming, Massive MIMO, and emerging 6G technologies.•    Specify new 5G/6G system features and functions, including requirements, test cases, algorithms, use cases, parameter settings, and interactions with existing functionality.•    Develop and use software simulations, primarily link-level, to analyse and optimise the performance of 5G/6G features and signal-processing algorithms.•    Contribute to the evolution of 5G/6G standards, including analysing relevant specifications and maintaining our Statement of Compliance.•    Contribute to innovation and Ericsson IPR, including invention disclosures and patents.•    Support the deployment of new 5G/6G products and features into customer networks through network analysis, troubleshooting, and investigation of customer configurations and issues.•    Work closely with cross-functional development teams, locally and globally, on new features, simulations, and improvements.•    Explore opportunities to apply AI/ML in radio systems, as well as AI-assisted tools for simulation, development, analysis, and engineering workflows.
  
 Skills you bring
 •    MSc or PhD in a relevant field such as Wireless Communications, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, Mathematics, or a related area.•    Strong background in communication theory, digital signal processing, and mathematics.•    Strong knowledge of LTE, NR/5G, and 3GPP specifications, particularly in the Physical Layer.•    Experience with software development for link-level simulations, using languages such as Python, C, and C++.•    Experience developing and analyzing software simulations; knowledge of simulation environments and tools such as MATLAB is an advantage.•    An analytical and result-oriented mindset, with the ability to investigate complex problems and deliver under pressure.•    Ability to manage multiple activities and meet deadlines while working across different projects.•    Strong English communication skills, both verbal and written, and the ability to explain technical topics and build effective relationships with colleagues and external stakeholders.•    A motivated, proactive, and collaborative approach, with the ability to work independently when needed and contribute effectively as part of a team.•    Interest in AI/ML and AI-assisted engineering is a plus, but strong wireless communication and signal-processing fundamentals are the foundation for the role.

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Analyst  Trade & Financial Markets - 20875/20938
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for an experienced Senior Business Analyst to join a large transformation programme focused on developing a next-generation Trade Surveillance platform.
The platform is designed to identify and manage potential market abuse and ensure regulatory compliance across global financial markets.
You will act as a key link between business and IT, translating complex business needs into clear functional requirements. You will work closely with international surveillance teams in Europe and the USA, as well as development, product and other stakeholder teams.
What You Will Work On
Gather, analyse and translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria.
Define, document, prioritize and test data-related and functional requirements.
Ensure solutions balance business needs, technical feasibility and business value.
Collaborate with international Surveillance teams, Commercial teams and System Engineering.
Support project planning, requirements gathering and delivery follow-up.
Identify and resolve delivery blockers.
Work with Risk, Compliance and Audit teams to validate requirements and address issues.
Manage and prioritize the project backlog.
Establish and improve processes and governance routines.
Lead the calibration and fine-tuning of surveillance models across asset classes, including equities and fixed-income instruments.
Support business-as-usual activities, including reviewing business initiatives, market abuse risk assessments and user queries.

What You Bring
Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Minimum 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst or Product Analyst within capital markets, financial technology or a regulated trading environment.
Strong understanding of trading data structures, trading protocols, order management, execution flows and exchange rules.
Knowledge of financial instruments and asset classes, including equities, fixed income, derivatives, futures, forwards and options.
Proven ability to translate complex business and technical requirements into functional specifications, user stories and data flow diagrams.
Experience working in agile delivery environments.
Experience with JIRA and cross-functional development and product teams.
Strong analytical skills and advanced SQL-based data analysis capabilities.
Good English communication skills.

Meritorious
Experience with Trade Surveillance, compliance monitoring or regulatory frameworks such as MAR, MiFID II, FINRA, Nasdaq Market Model and Exchange Rules.
Experience with large-scale data integrations and multi-asset market data flows.
Knowledge of instrument reference data and differences between financial products from a surveillance perspective.
Experience working with global teams and international stakeholders.
Experience with surveillance platforms such as NMS, NTS, Actimize, Trading Hub, Scila or similar.
Understanding of surveillance system calibration.
Advanced JIRA experience, including backlog and sprint planning.
Experience with Tableau, Power BI or similar data visualization tools.

jobs.description:
Machine Learning & Software Engineer – Edge AI & Autonomous Systems
Company: Aeronis AB
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
Employment: Full-time
Expected start date: 1 January 2027

Aeronis AB is a Swedish deep-tech company developing edge intelligence solutions for space, airborne and ground-based systems. Our technologies combine artificial intelligence, machine learning, distributed computing and sensor data processing to support autonomous operations and real-time decision-making.
We work across space, defence, critical infrastructure, energy and industrial applications, collaborating with research institutions, industry partners and innovation programmes in Sweden and internationally.
About the Role
We are looking for a motivated Machine Learning & Software Engineer to join our growing technical team in Gothenburg.
The successful candidate will contribute to the development, integration and validation of AI-enabled software solutions for distributed and autonomous systems.
This is a hands-on technical role involving software development, machine learning, sensor data processing, experimentation and system integration.
Key Responsibilities
Develop, implement and test software components using Python and other relevant programming technologies.

Design, train and evaluate machine learning and AI models for real-time applications.

Work with sensor data, telemetry, anomaly detection and intelligent data processing.

Support the development of distributed AI and autonomous systems.

Contribute to multi-agent intelligence, robotics and sensor-fusion applications.

Integrate AI models with edge computing platforms and embedded or distributed systems.

Perform software testing, validation, performance evaluation and technical documentation.

Collaborate with engineers, researchers and project partners on R&D activities and demonstrators.

Support technical investigations, prototypes and the preparation of project deliverables.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence or a related discipline.

Practical experience in software development, preferably using Python.

Knowledge of machine learning principles, algorithms and model evaluation.

Familiarity with AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or Scikit-learn.

Understanding of software integration, data processing and testing.

Good analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.

Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.

Good command of English, written and spoken.

Desirable Experience
Experience with distributed systems, edge computing or embedded AI.

Knowledge of reinforcement learning or multi-agent systems.

Experience in robotics, autonomous systems or intelligent sensor processing.

Familiarity with SQL, databases and telemetry data.

Knowledge of cybersecurity, resilient systems or safety-critical applications.

Experience working on research projects, technical prototypes or industry-funded R&D programmes.

What We Offer
Opportunity to work on innovative technologies across space, AI and autonomous systems.

Hands-on involvement in research, software development and product commercialisation.

Collaboration with an international engineering team and research partners.

A dynamic startup environment with opportunities for professional growth.

The opportunity to contribute to the development of new technologies from concept to demonstration.

Application
Please submit your CV and a short introduction highlighting your relevant software development, machine learning and technical project experience.
Contact: info@aeronissolutions.com
Website: www.aeronissolutions.com

At Electrolux Professional Group we hire to meet needs beyond tomorrow!  
UNLOCK YOUR POTENTIAL  
At Electrolux Professional Group, we believe potential powers progress. We’re not searching for perfection—we’re looking for people with the right mindset. If you're curious, resilient, and ready to grow, you'll find the space to lead, innovate, and together with us Meet the needs beyond tomorrow. Read more about us here: https://www.electroluxprofessionalgroup.com/en/join-us/  
SOFTWARE TEST ENGENEER 
At Electrolux Professional, we're looking for three Software Test Engineers to join our R&D Lab in Ljungby and help shape the next generation of connected professional laundry solutions. 
In this role, you'll ensure that our software delivers the quality, reliability, and performance our customers depend on every day. Working closely with developers and cross-functional engineering teams, you'll play a key role in validating features, identifying improvements, and driving continuous quality throughout the development process. 
If you're passionate about testing, problem-solving, and turning complex technical challenges into robust solutions, then this is an opportunity where you can make a real impact! 
WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING  
Perform software testing and validation activities. 
Test new software releases to ensure functionality, stability, and compliance with requirements. 
Develop, execute, and maintain test cases and test procedures. 
Identify, document, and track software defects. 
Collaborate closely with software developers to investigate and resolve issues. 
Perform regression testing to ensure existing functionality is not affected by software changes. 
Support Software Quality Assurance (SQA) processes and continuous improvement activities. 
Report test results, issues, and validation status to the team. 

 
WHAT’S NEEDED FOR YOU TO THRIVE  
Good understanding of software testing methodologies and SQA principles. 
Experience in functional testing, regression testing, and defect management. 
Ability to analyze software requirements and translate them into test cases. 
Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. 
Familiarity with bug-tracking and test-management tools (e.g., Jira). 
Good communication skills and ability to work closely with software developers. 
Ability to work independently and as part of an international team. 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering or relevant field 
Fluent in English, both written and spoken. 

 
Advantage: 
Software skills (Python, C, C# or equivalent) 
Basic electronic skills (hardware) 
 

To be eligible for this role, you must already have the legal right to work in Sweden.  
OUR GUIDING PRINCIPLES   
Be Customer Obsessed. Build Trust. Be Bold. Act Sustainably. We’re building it every day — and we’d love your help.   
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU  
Trust, ownership, and the opportunity to grow! Be part of a company grounded in customer focus, sustainability leadership, innovation, and social impact.  
We aim to Meet Needs Beyond Tomorrow!  
Some of our benefits:  
Occupational pension plan  
Collective agreement  
Lunch benefits  
Massage at the office at discounted price  
Wellness allowance  
Beniflex (discounts on purchases)  
Parental leave benefits etc.

Job Scope 

Why does the role exist? High level purpose of function. 

The key responsibilities of manager quality control are to plan, manage and coordinate the activities of the Cell Analysis lab at Lyten Labs, including the chemical, mechanical and failure analysis teams. 

Purpose is to secure reliable, traceable pipeline and on-time quality control for incoming material, production samples and to support material development with analytical capability and instrumentation expertise. Lead the development of laboratories into one standardized and scalable organization. 

Key Responsibilities 

Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to) 

Lead by example and safety-first principle 

Lead the quality control team members 

Plan, organize and review organization, competences, development and training of the lab 

Plan and align the resources and the demand across team members 

Ensure the lab works according to the scope of internal laboratory and the analytical scope and ownership matrix 

Ensure methods, SOP’s, risk assessments and work instructions are developed, implemented and reviewed according to the company rules and guidelines 

Ensure the laboratory utilities/equipment are maintained, calibrated and safe to use, including MSA and method validation 

Plan and implement new methods, equipment and lab capabilities 
Manage product and process deviations, NCM’s and escalations towards stakeholders 

Define follow up and report lab KPI’s  

Manage improvements, the implementation and maintain 5S in the Cell Analysis lab 

Represent the lab in internal, customer and supplier audits 

Plan and follow up the lab budget and investments 

Attest time reports on time and ensure to comply with local and companywide processes 

 

Accountability/Authorization 

Budget responsibility: Yes 

Direct reports: Yes 

Work Environment responsibility: Yes 

Authorized to decide on investments according to role and policy 

 

Requirements 

Educational background and previous experience required for the role 

BS or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Material Science, Natural Science or Engineering 

10+ years of relevant work experience in quality assurance, metrology or laboratory testing in automotive, medical or battery industry 

 

Qualifications and Experience 

Proven experience in leadership of international team

Intermodulation Products AB is a pioneering company developing advanced test and measurement equipment for the quantum technology sector. As we continue to expand the reach of our flagship Presto platform, we are looking for a highly technical and outgoing Quantum Application Engineer to join our team in Stockholm.
In this role, you will be the crucial link between our technology and the global physics community. Your primary focus will be helping existing and potential customers understand how Presto can solve their most complex measurement needs across superconducting circuits, quantum sensing, computing, and communication. You will own and run live demonstrations using our in-house superconducting qubit setup, represent us at scientific conferences, and provide critical technical support for both sales and existing users. You will also travel to customer laboratories, spending time with researchers to deeply understand their experimental workflows and pain points, and bring those insights directly back to our development team. This role is perfect for a physicist who loves being hands-on with technology but finds it equally fun and energizing to interact with people.
Responsibilities
Help existing and potential customers understand how the Presto platform solves specific measurement challenges in quantum tech and RF.
Own, maintain, and present live technical demonstrations using our superconducting qubit setup.
Represent the company at international scientific conferences, presenting our products at the booth and engaging with fellow physicists.
Partner with the sales team to provide technical pre-sales support and system configuration advice.
Assist customers with high-level technical support questions and troubleshooting.
Travel to customer labs to spend time on-site, understanding their measurement pain points and workflows.
Act as the voice of the customer, forwarding field knowledge and feature requests to our internal development team.

Requirements
PhD (preferred) or MSc in Physics, Applied Physics, Quantum Engineering, or a highly related field.
Strong background in experimental physics with hands-on knowledge of microwave and low-temperature measurements.
A highly technical mindset coupled with a strong willingness and enthusiasm to engage, network, and interact with fellow physicists.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex measurement concepts clearly.
Willingness and ability to travel to scientific conferences and customer laboratories globally.
Good written and spoken English.

Meritorious Qualifications: You do not need to have experience in all of the areas below. Experience in one or more is considered an advantage:
Experience with Python programming, specifically for data acquisition, instrument control, and data analysis.
Previous experience in technical sales, field application engineering, or customer-facing scientific support.
Hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting dilution refrigerators or other cryogenic systems.
Practical experience working directly with superconducting qubits or similar solid-state quantum devices.
Familiarity with RF/microwave instrumentation (e.g., AWGs, VNAs, digitizers, spectrum analyzers).
Experience with experimental control software and quantum measurement frameworks (e.g., QCoDeS, Labber, Qiskit Experiments).
Basic understanding of FPGA-based signal processing.

Studies in project management, game production, business, or a related field.

A modern office in central Stockholm.

The opportunity to create games with a global audience.
Real influence, ownership, and personal growth opportunities.
